Do you ship internationally, and who covers customs or duties?
We don't offer cross-border shipping, so each regional site only ships within its own region. The US site (awaytravel.com) ships to US addresses, the Canada site (awaytravel.com/en-ca) ships within Canada, and the UK site (awaytravel.com/en-gb) ships within the UK.
Since orders are fulfilled and delivered within the same region, customs and duties typically don't apply to standard regional shipments. If you're trying to send something to a country outside our shipping regions, that wouldn't be possible through our site.
